requirements.verifier_assertion: gradio module exposes EventRecorder, replay_events, load_events, ReplayReport, ReplayResult at the top level (test_public_api_exported).
EventRecorder constructor accepts blocks, path, include, exclude, redact keyword arguments (test_include_and_exclude_filters, test_redaction_by_exact_label).
is_recording property reflects state: False before start, True after start, False after stop (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format, test_not_recording_before_start_and_after_stop).
start() and stop() are idempotent — calling either repeatedly does not error and does not corrupt state (test_not_recording_before_start_and_after_stop).
start() returns the recorder itself, enabling chaining like gr.EventRecorder(demo, path).start() (used throughout test_outputs.py).
The `with gr.EventRecorder(demo, path) as rec:` form starts recording on enter and stops+detaches on exit (test_context_manager_records_and_detaches).
close() stops recording and removes every hook — after close(), demo.get_call_hooks() is empty (test_recorder_registers_as_call_hook, test_context_manager_records_and_detaches).
must_include: close() stops recording and fully detaches
not a single hook of the recorder remains attached

requirements.verifier_assertion: The recording file appears on disk only after start() — mere construction of EventRecorder does not create the file (test_not_recording_before_start_and_after_stop).
must_include: the recording file is created only when start() is called
constructing the recorder must not create it on disk

requirements.verifier_assertion: Missing parent directories of the recording path are auto-created (used implicitly by tmp_path/'rec.jsonl' patterns; verified in the loader's happy path).
must_include: Missing parent directories of the path must be auto-created

requirements.verifier_assertion: Each recorded event is flushed to disk immediately so a mid-run crash does not lose recorded events (contract, backed by the sync-write semantics required by concurrency test).
must_include: Every event, once written, is flushed to disk immediately

requirements.verifier_assertion: Multiple recorders may be attached to the same app at once, each writing its own file (test_multiple_recorders_independent_files).
must_include: Multiple recorders may attach to the same app at the same time, each writing to its own file

requirements.verifier_assertion: rec.events returns a copy of the recorded events; callers may inspect and mutate without affecting the recorder's internal list (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format uses `assert events == rec.events`).
must_include: rec.events returns a copy of the recorded events

requirements.verifier_assertion: include filter admits only listed api/fn names; exclude filter removes listed names from recording (test_include_and_exclude_filters).
must_include: include=[...] is a whitelist of api_name / fn_name

requirements.verifier_assertion: redact= list masks inputs by exact component label; recorded value is the placeholder "***"; the function receives real inputs (test_redaction_by_exact_label).
must_include: masks sensitive fields by exact component label
the function still receives the real inputs

requirements.verifier_assertion: Recording works at the Blocks.process_api layer regardless of trigger origin (direct call, HTTP route, queue); no server required (test_http_queue_calls_are_recorded, test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format).
must_include: The recording hook sits at the Blocks call layer (the process_api layer)
Recording itself must not depend on starting a server

requirements.verifier_assertion: Plain inputs recorded as raw frontend payload; plain outputs recorded as post-processed value (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format).
must_include: record the raw payload sent from the frontend for inputs

requirements.verifier_assertion: State inputs recorded as the session value the function saw; State outputs recorded as the new session value after the call finishes (test_stateful_effective_values_recorded).
must_include: record the session value the function saw
record the new session value after the call finishes

requirements.verifier_assertion: On exception, event is recorded with outputs=None and error=exception class name string (test_error_event_recorded_and_exception_propagates).
Exception must propagate unchanged — recorder never swallows it (test_error_event_recorded_and_exception_propagates).
must_include: The exception itself must propagate unchanged

requirements.verifier_assertion: Generators: only the first call recorded; follow-up iterator calls not recorded (test_generator_records_first_call_only).
must_include: only the first call is recorded
Follow-up calls that carry an already-live iterator are not recorded

requirements.verifier_assertion: Non-serializable values fall back to their string representation (contract; used implicitly in canonical helper serialization).
must_include: Every recorded value must be JSON-serializable
fall back to their string form

requirements.verifier_assertion: Under multi-threaded concurrent calls: file remains valid JSONL, no lost events, no half/interleaved lines, dense unique indices (test_concurrent_recording_stays_intact).
With no recorder attached, process_api behavior unchanged: same result dict keys, same signatures (test_existing_behavior_unchanged_without_recorder).
must_include: With no recorder (and no hook) attached, existing app behavior must not change

requirements.verifier_assertion: With no hooks attached, process_api enters _process_api_impl directly (test_no_hooks_no_overhead_path): replacing type(demo)._process_api_impl wholesale is observed by every call.
must_include: real implementation body lives on the class attribute _process_api_impl
no wrapping layers may sit in between

requirements.verifier_assertion: Recording file is JSONL: header first, one event per subsequent line; content stable across repeated reads and repeated field ordering (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format, test_event_and_header_have_canonical_field_order).
must_include: First line is the file header
even field order must not jump around

requirements.verifier_assertion: Header line has type='header', format_version=1, gradio_version (non-empty string), created_at (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format).

Event line contains type, index (0-based), api_name, fn_name, session_hash, inputs, outputs, error, duration, timestamp — with duration>=0, timestamp>0, error null when no exception (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format, test_event_and_header_have_canonical_field_order).
must_include: duration is elapsed time in seconds and must be >= 0
error is null when no exception was raised

requirements.verifier_assertion: canonical_json_dumps orders keys alphabetically, keeps non-ASCII characters (ensure_ascii=False), rejects NaN/Infinity, tuples become lists, and uses the json.dumps default separators (", " between items, ": " after keys) so canonical({"b":1,"a":2}) == '{"a": 2, "b": 1}' (test_canonical_json_dumps_is_public_helper).
must_include: keys serialized in strictly alphabetical order

requirements.verifier_assertion: gradio.utils.canonical_json_dumps is a public helper; the recording writer uses it (test_canonical_json_dumps_is_public_helper).
The loader refuses tampered/reordered/dropped-event files (test_record_file_is_tamper_evident, test_record_file_rejects_reordered_events, test_record_file_rejects_dropped_event).
must_include: any silent drop of an event line

requirements.verifier_assertion: load_events(path) returns the events list excluding header (test_basic_event_fields_and_file_format uses assert events == rec.events).
must_include: load_events(path) returns the events list (excluding the header line)

requirements.verifier_assertion: load_events raises FileNotFoundError on missing file; raises ValueError on empty file, corrupt header, wrong format_version, corrupt event line (test_load_events_missing_file, test_load_events_rejects_bad_files).
must_include: raises FileNotFoundError if the file does not exist

requirements.verifier_assertion: replay_events(blocks, path, api_names=None) is the signature (test_replay_identical_app_matches, test_replay_api_names_filter).
Replay uses a fresh session and restores recorded stateful inputs before running (test_replay_restores_stateful_inputs).
must_include: Each event is replayed with a new session
stateful input values that were recorded at capture time must be restored

requirements.verifier_assertion: Calls produced during replay are not recorded by other recorders attached to the same app (test_replay_is_not_recorded).
must_include: Calls produced during replay must not be nested-recorded

requirements.verifier_assertion: Plain outputs compared by strict structural equality; exceptions compared by class name; empty report has ok=False (test_replay_identical_app_matches, test_replay_error_events_compared_by_exception_type, test_replay_empty_record_not_ok).
must_include: plain outputs compared by strict structural equality
exceptions compared by class name only
A report has ok=True only if everything matched
a report with zero events has ok=False

requirements.verifier_assertion: ReplayReport exposes total, matched, mismatched, missing, errors, results, mismatches, ok, summary(), to_dict(), __bool__ (test_replay_identical_app_matches, test_replay_detects_behavior_change).
ReplayResult carries index, api_name, fn_name, status, expected, actual — status is one of match/mismatch/missing/error (test_replay_identical_app_matches, test_replay_missing_function).
Blocks.add_call_hook(name, hook), remove_call_hook(name), get_call_hooks() are public (test_blocks_call_hooks_are_public_api, test_recorder_registers_as_call_hook).
must_include: get_call_hooks() returns the list of currently attached hook names

requirements.verifier_assertion: Hook is hook(phase, ctx) with phase 'before'/'after' and ctx dict of api_name/fn_name/session_hash/inputs/outputs/error/duration (test_blocks_call_hooks_are_public_api, test_call_hooks_receive_error_phase).
'before' phase has ctx.outputs=None; 'after' phase has ctx.error=exception class-name string when raised (test_blocks_call_hooks_are_public_api, test_call_hooks_receive_error_phase).
must_include: At the "before" phase, ctx['outputs'] is None
At the "after" phase, ctx['error'] is the exception's class-name string when the call raised

requirements.verifier_assertion: SessionState.snapshot()/restore(snapshot) are public; snapshot() returns a copy (mutating it doesn't touch the live session); restore reinstates exactly (test_session_state_snapshot_and_restore_public_api).
Existing gr.Blocks / SessionState APIs and repo unit tests must keep working (contract; test_existing_behavior_unchanged_without_recorder).
must_include: Existing gr.Blocks / gradio.state_holder.SessionState APIs, method signatures, and behavior must keep working
existing unit tests must not break

requirements.verifier_assertion: Contract for placement and style: code goes into appropriate gradio locations with consistent style and pytest coverage (final paragraph of instruction).
must_include: Put the code in appropriate locations inside the gradio package
